items.title: Run a 386 on Pico

items.title: Use syntax-aware Git merges

items.title: Migrate prompts to Ollama

items.oneliner: High-level DSL compiles SIMD-heavy algorithms to C, giving low-level performance without writing intrinsics by hand.

items.oneliner: Static site generator turns Git repositories into browsable pages, replacing heavyweight self-hosted forge stacks on small servers.
